params.random_state: Random seed, currently kept mainly for configuration consistency
params.write_excel: Whether to output the Excel report

level2.name: Labels, Scores, and Weights

params.score_cols: All score fields; when empty, base_score + comp_scores is used
params.split_col: Optional evaluation-set field; accepts any non-empty name such as ins/oos/oot/ft_oot, does no training split, and serves only as a default group dimension

rules: Either score_cols or base_score + comp_scores must be provided
If split_col is configured, values are stripped and lowercased, and it must contain at least one non-empty enumerated value

params.min_data_size: Minimum sample size for group evaluation

params.include_missing: Whether the binning/cross analysis includes missing
params.positive_score_only: Whether to treat scores on the positively oriented basis

params.custom_metric_cols: Default columns for extra mean metrics
params.gains_display_metric_list: List of metrics shown in the gains report

params.time_dims: List of time dimensions, default apply_month
params.population_dims: List of population dimensions, default channel
params.segment_dims: Compatible alias of population_dims; overrides population_dims once passed
params.include_time_population_cross: Whether to automatically generate the population x time cross groups
params.group_min_size: Minimum group sample size; when empty, inherits min_data_size
params.group_specs: Explicit grouping configuration; supports a named dict or a name/columns/min_size list, and once passed it overrides the automatic time/population/split combination

params.group_missing_values: Tokens treated as missing in group fields
params.drop_missing_group_values: Whether to convert tokens such as empty strings to NA and exclude them from the default groups

params.cross_vars: List of variables to run cross_risk on; empty by default
params.cross_metrics: cross_risk aggregation metrics; when empty, the target_col bad_rate and the custom_metric_cols means are used
params.cross_binning_numeric: The binning_numeric passed to cross_risk, which can be a bool or a list

params.pairwise_cross_agg_dict: Pairwise cross aggregation dict; when empty, the default bad_rate/custom metrics are used

requirement_note: The required category contains the data-field entry points that score comparison must confirm; either score_cols or base_score + comp_scores must be provided.

cross_metrics.validation: Each value must be a 2-tuple/2-element list; agg_col must exist; agg_func must be a string or a callable

pairwise_cross_agg_dict.validation: column must exist; aggregation must be a string or a callable
